statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Strong broad-index mean reversion keeps Tail low while concentrated semiconductor weakness, elevated yields and high oil keep Stress extreme.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. The observed price path remains recoverable; power-hour re-extension is the nearest conditional checkpoint.
headline: Broad-index repair keeps Tail low into power hour
body: The Nasdaq has repaired most of an early decline of more than 1% and was recently near flat, while the semiconductor index remained sharply lower. The 10-year Treasury yield briefly exceeded 5% and oil stayed above $100. Mean reversion suppresses Tail, while concentrated tech, rates and energy pressure keep Stress extreme.

lookbackSummary: Tail was low Sunday evening, rose to WATCH and elevated overnight and through much of Monday, then de-escalated as the U.S. cash session produced substantial broad-index mean reversion.
outlookSummary: Tail is low in the current power hour because the broad index has repaired substantially. Re-extension into the close is the nearest checkpoint; Tuesday's Empire State release and cash open can raise Tail only if observed price action becomes persistently one-way.

forecast.analysis: Observed power-hour structure remains low Tail: the Nasdaq has repaired most of an early loss of more than 1% and was recently near flat, while semiconductor weakness remains severe and rates/oil stay elevated.
drivers: PHLX semiconductor index remains sharply lower

forecast.analysis: At the cash-close checkpoint, Tail stays low if the afternoon repair holds; a renewed push toward session lows would be the main condition for late re-escalation.
drivers: Repair persistence versus renewed session-low pressure

forecast.analysis: Post-close risk is low if the repaired cash-session structure carries into futures. Thin liquidity can lift volatility without establishing a persistent one-way path.
Evening futures remain low Tail if two-way trade persists. Residual chip, oil and rate pressure mainly sustains Stress unless fresh extension appears.
Late-evening Tail stays low under orderly futures trade. A new geopolitical or rates shock would require fresh evidence before changing the path assessment.
Early overnight conditions remain low Tail if moves continue to retrace. Thin liquidity raises noise risk but not Tail by itself.
drivers: Retracement quality remains the key condition

forecast.analysis: Asia-session baseline is low Tail if price action remains two-way. Persistent extension without meaningful pullbacks would invalidate this baseline.
During the Asia handoff, Tail remains low if directional moves retain meaningful retracements and cross-assets do not re-align into a fresh shock.
Late Asia remains low Tail under orderly price discovery. Energy or rates headlines could lift Stress before they establish mean-reversion failure.
Europe-open risk remains low Tail if the overnight range stays two-way. A one-direction European impulse would need persistence before changing the regime.
As Europe develops, Tail edges higher only if cross-asset pressure begins to align with directional Nasdaq futures; otherwise the baseline remains mixed and recoverable.
Approaching the U.S. premarket, Tail remains low unless overnight structure has become directionally efficient. Known U.S. data risk begins to matter more for Stress.
Europe-open Tail stays low if overnight trade remains two-way. A renewed cross-asset risk-off impulse would require fresh confirmation rather than extrapolation from Monday.
European follow-through remains low Tail if index futures retain meaningful retracements. Persistent directional efficiency would be the condition for escalation.
Mid-European-session Tail remains low under balanced futures trade. Oil, yields and semiconductor tone remain contextual amplifiers, not proof of a one-way NQ path.
drivers: Oil and yields as cross-asset context

forecast.analysis: As U.S. premarket liquidity builds, Tail stays low unless cross-asset pressure aligns with persistent futures extension and shallow pullbacks.
Ahead of the 12:30 UTC Empire State release, Tail moves to WATCH as a checkpoint state; escalation still requires observed persistent directional structure.
drivers: Observed structure remains the Tail trigger

forecast.analysis: The 12:30 UTC Empire State release falls inside this hour. Tail reaches upper WATCH conditionally; the release outcome and market reaction are not assumed in advance.
The 13:30 UTC U.S. cash open is the next checkpoint after Empire State. Tail remains upper WATCH only if the opening auction develops one-way extension with shallow pullbacks.
Post-open Tail can ease from upper WATCH if two-way rotations and meaningful retracements appear. Repeated extension after failed pullbacks would preserve the higher state.
Late-morning Tail stays at WATCH only if directional efficiency persists after the opening sequence. Broader mean reversion would move the path back toward low.
drivers: Depth of mean reversion after the open

forecast.analysis: Midday Tail returns to low if the data and opening moves have produced meaningful retracements. Volatility alone would keep Stress high without establishing Tail failure.
drivers: Volatility affects Stress more than Tail

forecast.analysis: Early-afternoon Tail remains low under balanced trade. A fresh catalyst would need to produce persistent one-way structure before materially changing the path.
Ahead of the next power hour, Tail stays low if price discovery remains balanced. Sensitivity rises only if the session starts holding near an extreme with failed retracements.

forecastDetail.comment: Observed broad-index repair keeps Tail low despite severe semiconductor weakness and elevated rates/oil; power-hour re-extension is the immediate checkpoint.
Cash-close Tail stays low if the afternoon repair holds; renewed session-low pressure would be the main invalidation.
Post-close Tail remains low if repaired cash-session structure carries into futures despite thinner liquidity.
Evening Tail stays low under two-way trade; residual chip, oil and rate stress does not by itself imply mean-reversion failure.
Late-evening Tail remains low absent a fresh geopolitical or rates shock that creates persistent directional structure.
Overnight Tail remains low if moves continue to retrace; thin liquidity raises noise more than Tail.
